lenses.verdict: Scrolling home-m-js-full.png once at 390, the three sections cost me about one and a half screens and I understood all of them in one pass: the day/night pair plus three big numbered lines tells a first-time buyer how solar works without a single number I have to trust, the winter note reads as the store being straight with me («זה נכון לכל תאורה סולארית, גם שלנו») and the fit rows right under it answer the «so what do I do» that the note raises, and the fence band is a pleasant breath before the three numbers. Every body line is 16 px or larger on the plain night ground at 16:1+ contrast and each winter line fits on one line at both 390 and 360 (winter-m.png, winter-s.png); the two frame headlines and the fence sentence are legible at phone widths (p90 6.7:1, 4.5:1, 6.7:1). What I noticed and minded: the page now says «when it gets dark the light comes on» four times (hero, night frame, step 2, band sentence), and step 2 sits 77 px under the frame headline saying the same thing, which is exactly the «nothing twice» the owner asked to stop; the only text that is actually unreadable is the 12 px «יום» corner tag lost on the pink foliage (p90 1.75:1), which I do not need because the photo is obviously daytime. The fence photo does feel like the same store as the cards above (warm bulbs, blue hour, the same product-frame look), but it is the one thing on the page I wanted to buy and cannot tap. Nothing delays me, nothing worries me, and I would keep scrolling.

Yes, this is the shape of what I asked for: three sections, not more, each one led by a photograph, and every photograph is mine (powerful-solar-garden-light frames 2 and 3, modern-solar-path-lights-set frame 6, solar-crystal-ball-string-lights frame 5), so nobody else's lamps and no credit lines — using my listing frames as home-page scenery is right for me, and the day/night pair at 1366 (solar-d.png) and the fence at 390 (band-m.png) are the two most beautiful screens the home has had. But my verdict of 2026-09-05 was «nothing twice», and this round says things twice three times over: the card «מנורת גינה סולארית עוצמתית» sits directly above a diptych made of that same product's own frames (m-grid-solar crop, y≈1900→2450 at 390); inside the diptych the two headlines «ביום נטען. / בלילה נדלק.» are repeated under the frames as steps 1 and 2 «הפאנל נטען לאור היום. / כשמחשיך, האור נדלק לבד.»; and the band's «חושך הוא לא סוף הערב.» is the hero's «כשהשמש יורדת, הגינה נדלקת.» said a second time in the hero's own form (full-bleed photo + one serif sentence). Two texts also fail the 4.5:1 floor I was told is a rule: the «יום» corner label (p90 1.45–1.81:1 in every viewport, invisible in solar-d.png) and the band sentence at 1366 (p90 3.93:1, a bulb glowing behind «לא» and another behind «סוף» in band-d.png). I would sign the copy list in SPEC §2 with three changes: delete the two corner labels, delete steps 1 and 2 (keep «בלי כבל, בלי חשמלאי.» as the one line under the frames), and give the band a different thought or no sentence at all. 6.84 screens is still simple enough because I asked for the growth, but note that P5 still reads «home ≤ 6» and the winter is now the sixth bollard photograph on one page — the next image round should show a wall or a spot.

Copy: every rendered string in sizes.json (all three viewports) is byte-identical to SPEC §2 — no number other than the three <bdi> step numerals, no rank, no urgency, no review, no «+»/«;», periods only on sentences; the winter lines are daylight physics and the third line («זה נכון לכל תאורה סולארית, גם שלנו») is the brand's honesty said out loud; the band sentence makes no claim. Images: I read all four frames at d and the theme assets themselves — no text, logo, badge, face or foreign mark survives; the night asset's bottom 220 px is bare pavement (the «אור חם ומרשים» caption is outside the 1254×1090 crop), and the winter asset (1100×580 cut from own_modern-solar-path-lights-set_6) carries none of the source creative's headline, «4 או 8» badge or icon strip; CHOSEN.md and manifest.jsonl both record the four ids as store-product-image / store-owned / author ElmsNest on this store's own cdn.shopify.com path (s/files/1/0689/4927/8894), so no credit is owed and none is claimed. The winter picture is honest as atmosphere: it is the store's own bollards on a wet lawn in rain, not somebody else's lamps, and the copy under it does not say those lamps shine like that in January. The one real problem is scope on the phone: the 13 px muted eyebrow «תאורה סולארית» is the only thing separating «בלי כבל, בלי חשמלאי» / «נדלק לבד» from a product grid whose first card, 90 px above it, is the mains wall light with no «סולארי» in its title — a first-time shopper reads the 28 px headlines and 16 px steps and can carry them onto that card. Two smaller items: «בלי כבל» is literally false for the store's own separate-panel solar products (floodlight «פאנל נפרד», string lights with a panel lead), and the «יום» corner label is unreadable on the bright day frame (p90 1.45–1.81:1), which I flag as cross-lens because the label carries no claim.

The idea is right and the images are the store's own: the diptych reads day→night in the order a Hebrew reader expects (day on the right, night on the left, steps 1→2→3 right to left), the winter frame continues the night frame's palette so A and B are one argument, and the fence band after the fit rows is a genuine breath, placed with the same 56+72 rhythm the existing sections already use (128 px at 1366, 88 px at 390 — no finding there). The craft misses are all about text on photographs: the 12 px «יום» tag is a ghost on the orange hedge at every width (1.45–1.81:1), the glow headline «בלילה נדלק.» sits on the lit pavement rays and dips under the floor at 360 (4.43:1), and at 1366 the lower bulb string runs straight through both lines of «חושך הוא לא / סוף הערב.» (3.93:1) with the fade already on — a fade cannot darken a light source, the sentence has to move off the string. Smaller things a studio would tidy: the nearest lamp crown touches the day frame's top edge at 1366, the step hairline sits 8 px under the diptych and reads as three underlines, the winter h2 is 34 px next to a 44 px «מתי כן, ומתי לא», and the winter photograph is the only photo on the page wearing a hairline border. Fix the three contrast items and the composition holds.
